name: Accessible Calendar
description: Provides accessible month and week calendar displays for Views results.
project_description: Accessible Calendar provides month and week calendar displays for Views results in Drupal, with a strong accessibility focus that improves navigation, screen-reader announcements, and per-day context for assistive-technology users. It is a lightweight Views-based solution for presenting existing content in a calendar without introducing a separate event model: it works with standard Views results and one or more selected date fields, then renders them as accessible calendar tables with custom month/week pagers, an exposed "Jump to" filter, semantic table markup, hidden day summaries, aria-current on the current period, and focus/announce handling after AJAX navigation. It supports several date field types (date, created, changed, datetime, daterange, smartdate, timestamp), configurable first day of the week, an optional work-week (hide weekend) mode, tokenized calendar and row titles, and optional display of the original Views rows alongside the calendar. An optional companion submodule, Accessible Calendar - Multiday, adds metadata and CSS/JS to render events spanning multiple days as one continuous sequence.
